candidate: only after diagnosticGate, exit at next OPEN when prediction>0, otherwise fixed30; no added stop, threshold, reentry or winner filter
frozenComparator: reuse exact existing Candidate A policy and Fixed12 runtime on identical complete12-or-calendar-cap entry-relative paths, separate60/regular-bar comparator; do not change cap to30 and call it frozen. No fit calls through old module.

model.fitCount: one Entry diagnostic model; one EXIT diagnostic model on precommitted conditional Entry route; no refit after QUALIFY
model.objective: mean weighted squared error + alpha*sum(beta^2), intercept unpenalized
model.searchSpace: one fixed specification per component, no hyperparameter/threshold/horizon search
model.trigger: >0 predicted economic target; first positive state only; no tuning
model.weights: equal sessions then equal event identities then equal states within event

route: if Entry passes QUALIFY diagnostic+economic Gate, use locked research Entry candidate; else Immediate route. Route chosen before REPORT data are evaluated. No candidate silently created on failure.
state: 15/20/25m since selection, strictly after actual entry; prefix OHLC + entry-relative observed MFE/MAE; no future peaks/winners
value: 100*(next OPEN at state - selection30 CLOSE)/observed Entry price; incremental net value of exit now vs common fixed30, identical cost cancels
